abilities.effect: Wedges of sharpened stone extend from the barricade in all directions and attack all creatures within 10 feet.
abilities.name: Spike Jab

traits.name: Attack
traits.text: An ability with this trait involves an attack. For each attack you make beyond the first on your turn, you take a multiple attack penalty.

abilities.trigger: A creature enters the area adjacent to a barrier

traits.name: Reach
traits.text: This weapon can be used to attack enemies up to 10 feet away instead of only adjacent enemies. For creatures with reach, the weapon increases their reach by 5 feet.

hazard.description: Spring-loaded wedges of sharpened stone pop out of the wooden barricade.
hazard.disable: DC 33 Thievery (expert) to suppress the spring mechanism for one 5-foot segment of the barricade
hazard.name: Spiked Barricade Trap
hazard.reset: The trap must be manually reset by pushing the wedges back into place.
